channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Clica e Confirma destaca lançamento do Manual do Eleitor para as Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE's Clica e Confirma program launched the new edition of the Voter's Manual for the 2026 elections, presented by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, who described it as 'a statute of citizenship'. The guide outlines rights, duties, and guidance for exercising citizenship throughout the electoral process. The edition also features an interview on Brazil's Electoral Justice participation in international observation missions in Peru and Colombia, and highlights the ban on broadcasting programs featuring pre-candidates starting June 30.

item.title: PT muda de ideia e decide fazer a convenção de Lula no dia 2/8 em SP
item.description: The PT has decided to change the date and location of the convention that will officially nominate President Lula for re-election, moving from August 1st in Brasília to August 2nd in São Paulo. The party leadership stated that São Paulo is the political birthplace of the PT, Lula, and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, and is the country’s largest electoral college, making it strategically important for Lula’s re-election campaign.

item.title: Governo anuncia 20 medidas voltadas à agricultura familiar além de Plano Safra
item.description: The Lula government announced 20 new measures targeting family farming, integrated into the 2026/27 Family Farming Harvest Plan, focusing on rural credit, technical assistance, and cooperative strengthening. The initiatives aim to reduce rural inequalities and ensure food security for small producers. The announcement was made in Brasília on Tuesday, the 30th.

item.title: Senadora aciona PGR contra conselheiro de Flávio Bolsonaro por ataque a mulheres
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) has requested the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to investigate blogger Paulo Figueiredo, advisor to presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), for alleged gender-based political violence, slander, and defamation against Michelle Bolsonaro and Damares Alves. Figueiredo reportedly stated that 'women vote badly for fuck's sake', especially single women, and attacked Michelle with terms like 'tigrona' and 'tchutchuca', while dismissing her speech as 'prejudiced'. He also called Damares Alves a 'clown' and 'scoundrel' for her stance on Flávio Bolsonaro's meetings with women.

item.title: A nova sondagem Datafolha sobre a disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro em São Paulo
item.description: Datafolha will publish on Sunday, July 5, 2026, a new voting intention poll for the Brazilian presidency, focusing on São Paulo voters. The survey will include 1,608 interviews with a two-point percentage margin of error. It will test first-round scenarios and three potential second-round matchups, all featuring Lula (PT) against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), or Romeu Zema (Novo).

item.title: ‘Ninguém é dono da América do Sul’, diz Lula em recado a Trump
item.description: At the Mercosul summit in Asunción, Lula defended regional autonomy by stating that 'nobody owns South America,' criticizing global protectionism and automatic alignments with major powers. He proposed Brazil’s Pix instant payment system as a model for a shared financial infrastructure to reduce transaction costs, boost intrabloc trade, and enhance financial sovereignty. Lula also stressed the need for a regional strategy to exploit critical minerals essential for energy transition and technology, amid growing interest from foreign powers.

item.title: Senado pode votar urgência para regulamentar ensino domiciliar
item.description: Senators allied with PL presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro are pushing to approve an urgency request to vote on a bill regulating homeschooling in Brazil. The proposal was already passed by the Chamber of Deputies in 2022 and is currently stalled in the Senate Education Committee without a designated rapporteur. Education organizations oppose the measure, citing risks to educational quality and universality.

item.title: Noruega vence a Costa do Marfim e enfrentará o Brasil nas oitavas da Copa
item.description: Norway defeated Ivory Coast 2-1 in Dallas to reach the Round of 16 at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, where they will face Brazil in New Jersey on July 5. Erling Haaland scored the winning goal in the 86th minute, following an early strike by Antonio Nusa and an equalizer from Amad Diallo. Norway showed tactical discipline and mental resilience, capitalizing on Ivory Coast's defensive lapses to secure the victory.

item.title: Dino libera processo sobre sucessão no governo do Rio para julgamento no STF
item.description: Justice Flávio Dino has returned the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial succession case to the STF after requesting a vista to await the TSE’s ruling that confirmed Cláudio Castro’s ineligibility until 2030. The judgment is expected to resume in August, with a current 4-1 majority favoring indirect selection by the state legislature (Alerj), while only Justice Cristiano Zanin advocates for a direct election. The state is currently led on an interim basis by TJ-RJ President Ricardo Couto, who is in a coma, leaving the succession uncertain until the STF defines the process for the temporary mandate lasting until January 2027.

item.title: Lei autoriza isenção do ISS para empresas ligadas à Copa Feminina de 2027
item.description: President Lula signed Law 232/2026, authorizing municipalities and the Federal District to grant ISS tax exemptions for companies involved in organizing the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil. The exemption is not automatic and requires local legislation, with its duration tied to federal fiscal incentives. The tournament will be held in eight Brazilian cities and marks the first edition hosted in South America.

item.title: Fux vai presidir Segunda Turma do STF a partir de agosto
item.description: Minister Luiz Fux will preside over the Second Chamber of the STF starting in August, replacing Gilmar Mendes. The chamber is responsible for judging cases involving banker Daniel Vorcaro and the Operation Compliance Zero investigations into fraud at Banco Master. Fux emphasized the importance of ministers' independence in their decisions, even amid disagreements.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha mostra disputa Lula x Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: Datafolha will release, starting Sunday, July 5, a new poll on the 2026 presidential race in São Paulo state, Brazil’s largest electoral college. Conducted between July 1 and 3 with 1,608 voters and a two-point margin of error, the survey will measure voting intentions between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), along with rejection, vote potential, and candidate name recognition. The poll comes after recent political episodes, including the Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro controversy, the Banco Master case, and investigations into Jaques Wagner, offering an early gauge of their impact on São Paulo voters.

item.title: Fachin sugere rever pagamentos do serviço público inteiro após polêmica com penduricalhos
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin called for a structural reflection on payments across the entire Brazilian public service following his vote to release part of the 'penduricalhos' (extra benefits) for judges and Public Ministry members. The proposal comes amid controversy over the decision that favored these groups, sparking debate on equity and public spending.

item.title: A ofensiva judicial do PT contra Flávio Bolsonaro após carta de Marco Rubio
item.description: The PT filed two legal actions against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and the Liberal Party, claiming Marco Rubio's letter shows improper foreign influence in Brazilian politics and potential violations of the Political Parties Law. The party requests a criminal investigation for passive corruption, breach of functional secrecy, and offenses against national sovereignty, along with an inquiry into alleged PL subordination to U.S. interests.

item.title: Caiado compara seu futuro vice com herói da virada do Brasil sobre o Japão
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD's presidential candidate for 2026, announced that Gilberto Kassab, the party's national president, will be his running mate, acknowledging the choice may initially fail to excite voters. He compared the decision to Gabriel Martinelli's substitute appearance in Brazil's match against Japan, where he entered late and scored the winning goal — symbolizing a strategic, surprising move that pays off. Although Caiado avoided officially confirming Kassab's name, he emphasized the PSD will form a pure-party ticket while remaining open to broader alliances, even as his candidacy remains stalled at 5% in polls.

item.title: Defesa esclarece a Moraes estado de saúde de Bolsonaro e arma em prisão domiciliar
item.description: The defense of former President Jair Bolsonaro met with Minister Alexandre de Moraes to clarify Bolsonaro's health status and the situation of the firearm he kept under house arrest. Lawyer Paulo Cunha Bueno confirmed the explanations were presented during Tuesday's meeting, October 30. The meeting took place within the scope of STF investigations involving Bolsonaro.

item.title: Chapa pura expõe fragilidade de Caiado, e Kassab foca em barganha no 2º turno
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD's presidential pre-candidate, is expected to announce Gilberto Kassab as his running mate in a ticket that fails to unify the party and underscores the weakness of his campaign, which remains stuck at 5% in polling, far from double digits. Despite talks with allies like Romeu Zema, Caiado failed to build a competitive alliance, while Kassab aims to lend institutional weight to the ticket, though his focus appears more on positioning for a potential second-round bargain than on consolidating a broad electoral base.

item.title: Alcolumbre diz que não vai acelerar nova pauta-bomba e governo Lula ganha fôlego
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated he will not accelerate the processing of the PEC establishing special retirement for community health agents, opting for the normal legislative procedure despite having included the proposal on Tuesday’s agenda. He conveyed this decision to Lula’s government, which gained political breathing room by avoiding an immediate confrontation in Congress. The move reflects a negotiation effort between the Legislative and Executive branches to maintain stability in ongoing social reform debates.

item.title: Lula descarta ‘abandonar’ Wagner após crise do Master e deve dividir palanque com o senador na Bahia
item.description: President Lula ruled out abandoning Senator Jaques Wagner despite pressure from the Federal Police and the Master case crisis, maintaining discreet support to avoid fueling Bolsonarist opposition. Lula and Wagner are expected to share a campaign platform in Bahia at a public event for the Salvador-Itaparica bridge, as the senator remains crucial for the Workers' Party campaign in the state, the country's fourth-largest electoral college. Although Wagner stepped back from his state government role to avoid tarnishing Lula's image, Lula's aides say their decades-long friendship and political alliance make any distancing effort unfeasible.

item.title: Projeto bolsonarista cria ‘declaração pública de posicionamento partidário’
item.description: Federal Deputy Capitão Augusto (PL-SP) proposed the Public Declaration of Partisan Positioning (DPPP), requiring political parties to formally state their positions on key national issues such as gun rights, abortion, same-sex marriage, and lowering the age of criminal responsibility. The bill calls for a national transparency portal managed by the TSE and mandates that pre-candidates sign a programmatic adherence term. The proposal has not yet been assigned to a committee by the Chamber’s Directive Board.

item.title: Nova lei prevê divulgação de sintomas para facilitar diagnóstico do câncer infantil
item.description: Law 15.442/2026, signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, amends the National Policy on Pediatric Oncology Care to require awareness campaigns on childhood cancer to prioritize the disclosure of main symptoms and clinical signs. The measure aims to improve early diagnosis and includes training for primary care health professionals. The law originated from Bill 1.986/2024 by Deputy Jefferson Campos (PL-SP) and was reported by Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF), and was sanctioned without vetoes.

item.title: Fila do INSS recua para 1,8 milhão de pedidos, o menor patamar em 21 meses, segundo o órgão
item.description: The INSS backlog dropped to 1.831 million requests in June, the lowest level in 21 months, down from a peak of 3.128 million in February. The government defines 'zeroing the backlog' as eliminating the 555,000 requests waiting over 45 days — still a significant challenge. Measures include hiring 300 social security analysts, expanding mutirões, and prioritizing maternity salary and social assessment claims.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro se reúne com Moraes e reitera pedido de domiciliar
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's lawyer, Paulo Cunha Bueno, met with Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes to reiterate the request for maintaining Bolsonaro's humanitarian house arrest, citing health conditions and denying that the firearm found at his residence constitutes a serious violation. The initial 90-day period of house arrest ended on June 25, and Moraes will decide whether to maintain or revoke the measure pending the outcome of the firearm investigation.

item.title: ‘Ninguém é dono da América do Sul’, diz Lula em discurso na cúpula do Mercosul
item.description: Lula defended the autonomy of Mercosul member states, stating that 'no one owns South America,' and criticized automatic alignments with external powers. He proposed Pix as a model for an integrated regional payment system and emphasized the need for regional cooperation to address natural disasters, referencing the earthquakes in Venezuela and the impending El Niño.

item.title: STF retomará em agosto o julgamento sobre a eleição no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The STF will resume in August its judgment on the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election, after Minister Flávio Dino’s request for vista was suspended and now returned. The case stems from successive resignations by Cláudio Castro, Thiago Pampolha, and Rodrigo Bacellar, leading to the interim assumption of office by Ricardo Couto. The PSD advocates for a direct election, while a majority of justices voted for indirect election, split on whether the vote should be secret or open.

item.title: Democracia voltou a ser ameaçada no mundo todo, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that democracy is under threat globally and in South America, citing the January 8 events as an attempted coup in Brazil. He emphasized Mercosur's historical role in defending democracy, criticized disinformation, and affirmed that popular will and democratic rules have prevailed despite challenges.

item.title: No Paraguai, Lula se reúne com presidentes do Chile e da Bolívia
item.description: Lula met with the presidents of Chile, José Antonio Kast, and Bolivia, Rodrigo Paz, on the sidelines of the Mercosul Summit in Asunción. He defended the bloc's autonomy and integration above ideological differences, despite the rise of right-wing governments in South America. The meetings took place amid regional geopolitical tensions and democratic challenges.

item.title: Vídeo: Ao vivo: CCJ debate contribuição previdenciária patronal - 30/6/26
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) held a live debate on 06/30/2026 regarding the employer's social security contribution, a key issue in fiscal and pension reform discussions. The debate took place alongside other legislative agendas, including regulation of compounding pharmacies and the legal framework for cybersecurity, highlighting Congress's focus on structural adjustments. Although the video references the 2026 elections in other sections, no specific candidates were named in this segment.

item.title: Dino libera ação que definirá eleição do Rio e processo será pautado em agosto em plenário
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court's ruling on the actions defining the format of the temporary mandate elections in Rio de Janeiro has been postponed to August. Minister Flávio Dino, who had requested more time to analyze the issue, has released the actions for the judgment to continue, which will be scheduled by Court President Edson Fachin after the judicial recess.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que não pretende mais conceder Linha 17 e outras quatro operadas pelo Metrô
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated he no longer intends to concession lines 1, 2, 3, and 15 of the Metro to private operators and aims to maintain public operation. He also revealed negotiations to have the Metro continue operating Line 17 (Gold), despite a current contract that would transfer it to ViaMobilidade starting in October. This marks the first time the governor admitted to changing his stance on the privatization of the state's metro system.

item.title: Presidente do Paraguai credita Lula por acordo Mercosul-UE
item.description: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña credited Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for the conclusion of the Mercosul-European Union trade agreement, praising Lula as a permanent force of integration over two decades. Peña expressed regret over Lula's absence at the agreement's signing ceremony in January and urged him to continue as a pillar of regional unity, emphasizing justice in trade for smaller, landlocked nations. The 68th Mercosul Summit took place in Asunción with all bloc leaders present except Argentine President Javier Milei.

item.title: Não é só Tarcisio x Haddad: quem são as três mulheres que querem governar São Paulo
item.description: The race for governor of São Paulo is polarized between Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT), who together account for nearly 80% of voting intentions. Three women — Vera Lúcia (PSTU), Izadora Dias (PCO), and Vivian Mendes (UP) — are presenting themselves as pre-candidates, but have not been included in recent polls due to lack of official registration and their parties' absence from Congress, which also excludes them from media debates.

item.title: Dino destrava ação no STF sobre eleições no Rio
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino completed his analysis and returned the case records to the STF in a lawsuit discussing the election model for the government of Rio de Janeiro, currently under the rapporteurship of Judge Ricardo Couto. The decision advances the judicial process on electoral rules in the state, with potential impact on the 2026 elections. The article is exclusive to subscribers of the originating outlet.

item.title: Depois de receber Flávio na Argentina, Milei esnoba cúpula do Mercosul
item.description: After hosting Brazilian senator and 2026 presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at the Olivos residence, Argentine President Javier Milei skipped the Mercosul summit, sparking speculation about his distancing from the regional bloc. The meeting with Bolsonaro underscores the growing ideological alignment between the two right-wing leaders. Milei’s absence from the Mercosul gathering was widely interpreted as a signal prioritizing bilateral alliances over multilateral commitments.

item.title: Lula manda recado a Trump em reunião do Mercosul: 'Ninguém é dono da América do Sul'
item.description: Lula criticized the notion that any country 'owns South America' during a Mercosul meeting in Paraguay, advocating for regional autonomy and dialogue with all nations. He also promoted the Pix payment system as a global model of financial inclusion and proposed its adoption across the bloc to reduce costs and strengthen intrabloc trade.

item.title: Tarcísio entrega estação da Linha 17: "Prometida para Copa de 2014"
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas inaugurated the Washington Luís station on Line 17-Gold of the São Paulo Metro, completing the line's 'Y' format and making it the first in the system with three terminal destinations: Morumbi, Congonhas, and Washington Luís. The new station adds 800 meters of track and requires passengers to transfer at Brooklin Paulista station to reach the new terminal, preserving the 'shuttle' format on other segments. The inauguration follows multiple operational failures on the line since its opening.

item.title: Alcolumbre mantém pressão sobre governo com votação de pauta-bomba
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre scheduled a vote on a PEC granting special retirement to community health agents, with a R$30 billion impact over 10 years, putting the government on alert. Lula authorized R$520 million for electoral propaganda — more than double Bolsonaro’s 2022 spending — while the PSD is set to announce Kassab as Caiado’s running mate this Wednesday, following pressure from the party’s founders. Meanwhile, the Instituto Conhecer Brasil, linked to Karina Gama, reported R$54 million in revenue in 2025, raising suspicions of public fund misappropriation.

item.title: Crusoé: Ricardo Salles nega intenção de substituir Romeu Zema
item.description: Federal deputy Ricardo Salles denied having any intention to replace Romeu Zema as the Novo party’s presidential candidate in 2026, stating that Zema remains the party’s nominee and that he himself is still running for the Senate in São Paulo. He suggested that strategic adjustments may be needed to improve Zema’s electoral viability.

item.title: Marília Ruiz fala sobre queda alemã: "Não vence mata-mata desde 7 x 1"
item.description: Marília Ruiz commented on Germany's elimination from the 2026 World Cup, noting the team has not won a knockout match since their 7-1 loss to Brazil in 2014. Germany lost to Paraguay on penalties (4-3) after a 1-1 draw in regular time, extending their negative streak in knockout games.

item.title: Crises na pré-campanha de Flávio atrasam articulações do PL nos estados
item.description: Crises in Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign — involving allegations of irregular financing for the film 'Dark Horse' and tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro — are delaying the PL's state-level candidate selections, particularly in Rio de Janeiro, where the party awaits a decision on the Senate seat vacated by Cláudio Castro. Party officials admit that time and energy spent managing internal conflicts are undermining the development of competitive state slates, with a decision expected this Friday, the 3rd, when Flávio visits Rio.

item.title: Oposição pressiona Lula com propostas linha-dura para segurança pública
item.description: Brazilian opposition is pressuring President Lula with hardline public security proposals, inspired by mass incarceration, to exploit growing voter concern over violence, which 30% cite as the top national issue. The debate intensified after the lethal police operation in Rio de Janeiro in October 2023 and the U.S. designation of Brazilian criminal factions as 'terrorists,' introducing a sovereignty element that polarizes the electorate between nationalists and internationalists. Lula aims to appear firm on security without seeming lenient, while the opposition seeks to reduce his frontrunner status by making this a central theme in the 2026 presidential pre-campaign.

item.title: Lula lança Plano Safra de R$ 525 bilhões para a agricultura empresarial; veja os principais números
item.description: President Lula launched the 2026/27 Harvest Plan with R$ 525.1 billion, an increase of R$ 9 billion from the previous cycle. The package allocates R$ 384.9 billion for financing and commercialization and R$ 140.2 billion for investments, including R$ 72.6 billion for Pronamp targeting medium-sized rural producers. Announced ahead of the 2026 elections, the plan underscores the government’s support for agribusiness.

item.title: Lula pede 1 minuto de silêncio pela Venezuela em cúpula do Mercosul
item.description: President Lula requested a minute of silence for Venezuela during the Mercosul summit in Asunción, honoring victims of the June 24 earthquake that has caused over 1,400 deaths and 60,000 disappearances. He emphasized international solidarity and confirmed Brazil’s humanitarian aid flights carrying medical supplies and field hospital materials, without affecting SUS reserves.

item.title: Crusoé: Pesquisa indica impacto de vídeo de Michelle para Flávio
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll revealed that Michelle Bolsonaro's video had a negative impact on Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, increasing his rejection among female voters from 56% to 58% between June 12 and 14. The result suggests that the communication strategy involving the former first lady may have harmed the image of the PL pre-candidate among female voters.

item.title: Sucessão e lealdade: As duas perguntas da pesquisa AtlasIntel que tiram o sono de Flávio e Michelle
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll raises two critical questions for the Bolsonaro family: who Jair Bolsonaro’s voters prefer as the 2026 presidential candidate (Flávio, Michelle, or neither), and who is seen as more loyal to the ex-president’s political line. Released after Michelle’s video accusing Flávio of humiliation, the survey highlights the family’s internal rift and the weakness of Bolsonarism among female voters, who constitute 52.5% of the Brazilian electorate.

item.title: Governo Lula propõe que população escolha destino de emendas e contrata mais atrito com Congresso
item.description: The Lula government proposes directing parliamentary amendments to a participatory budget, allowing citizens to decide how public funds are spent, with the possibility of canceling amendments if lawmakers agree. The initiative, submitted via official letter to Congress to amend the 2027 Budget Guidelines Law, faces resistance even within the ruling coalition, with critics warning of legislative overreach and supporters praising democratic budgeting. In 2026, parliamentary amendments are projected to reach R$ 50 billion, representing 20% of the Union’s total spending on investment and public administration maintenance.

item.title: Valdemar se reúne com Michelle após vídeo sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, met with Michelle Bolsonaro to ease family tensions after videos surfaced in which she accused Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliating and mistreating her. The meeting followed Flávio's apology and Valdemar's statement emphasizing party unity despite internal disagreements.

item.title: STF tem 3 votos para anular doação de fiel à Igreja Universal
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court has three votes (Edson Fachin, Cármen Lúcia, and Alexandre de Moraes) to reject a plea from the Universal Church of the Kingdom of God seeking to overturn a ruling that requires it to return donations made by a follower under claims of irresistible moral coercion and abuse of right. The virtual plenary vote ends on August 5. Minas Gerais courts ruled the donations were made under religious pressure, undermining the donor’s free will, and ordered the church to repay R$229,100 in material damages and R$12,000 in moral damages, plus interest and adjustment.

item.title: Inscrições para curso de formação de candidatas às Eleições 2026 terminam hoje, terça-feira (30)
item.description: Registrations for the 30th edition of the Electoral Candidates Course - Brazil Edition close today, Tuesday (30). Supported by the TSE and organized by the CIM/OEA, OEA School of Government, and Anadep, the initiative will select up to 580 women for hybrid training, including in-person sessions in Brasília on July 8-9 and a virtual session on July 17, aiming to strengthen women's political participation and cover topics such as women's rights and gender equity in the electoral process.

item.title: Crusoé: Kassab encontrou um vice para Caiado?
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD party, is set to meet with pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado to finalize the presidential ticket, with Kassab being named as Caiado's running mate. Kassab had previously been speculated as a potential vice-presidential candidate for Tarcísio de Freitas.
